question: Gandhi Jayanti marks the birthday of the father of the nation Mahatma Gandhi, who was born at __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Porbandar**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mahatma Gandhi**, the father of the nation, was born on **2nd October 1869** in **Porbandar**__.
 
• Porbandar is a coastal city in the Indian state of **Gujarat**.
 
• Gandhi Jayanti is celebrated annually to honor **Mahatma Gandhi's** contributions to India's independence movement.
 
• The day is marked by various activities such as prayer services, commemorative ceremonies, and cultural events across India.
 
• Gandhi's principles of **non-violence** and **truth** continue to inspire people globally.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Mahatma Gandhi** is also known for his role in leading the **Salt March** and the **Quit India Movement**.
 
• He was a proponent of **Satyagraha**, a form of non-violent resistance.
 
• His autobiography, "**The Story of My Experiments with Truth**", is a significant literary work that provides insights into his life and philosophy.
 
• Gandhi's legacy is honored through various institutions and memorials, including the **Gandhi Ashram** in Ahmedabad and the **Raj Ghat** in New Delhi.
